quest.title: Guest from Afar
quest.description: Lately, there's been some suspicious activity seen around Wangshu Inn. Verr Goldet is anxious about the inn's safety...

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Oh, is that one of our guests? My apologies, things have been awfully unusual around here lately...

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Our guests keep getting attacked by monsters nearby. Naturally, many are now less inclined to stay here.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: If this pattern continues, things will eventually escalate out of control.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Judging by your attire, you are a traveler, correct? Would you mind taking care of this on the inn's behalf?

response.speaker: Verr Goldet
response.text: So it's better that you deal with it instead. I will be sure to arrange adequate compensation.

response.speaker: Verr Goldet
response.text: Not very. In fact, they are the lesser of my concerns.

response.speaker: Verr Goldet
response.text: The bigger issue is... if any of them was unfortunate enough to run into a certain young gentleman...

response.speaker: Verr Goldet
response.text: His method of dealing with monsters tends not to consider the best interests of the surrounding area or the people in it...

talks.objective: Go and check the suspicious location

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Time is of the essence here. The young gentleman tends to show up without warning and disappear without a trace. There's no telling when he'll be here next.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: And in the event he does show up, that'll be us out of business for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Wonderful! Well, that's a load off my mind. Business as usual once again.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Hmm? Oh, the young gentleman? I would have thought you'd seen him around.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Perhaps you've noticed him resting on the roof of the inn? He does that occasionally.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: But if you do notice him, try not to disturb him. He prefers to be left alone.
